Desflurane has been shown to have no significant effect on left ventricular function when used as a control agent to manage intraoperative hypertension during cardiac surgery. This study indicates that desflurane is effective in controlling intraoperative hypertension without causing major adverse effects on cardiac function.

This means that when surgeons are managing patients undergoing vascular surgery, using desflurane to control excessive blood pressure can help them achieve their goals while minimizing the risk of harming the heart.
